title: Project Graph, Package Boundaries and Dependency Enforcement
objective: Classify every project with Nx-compatible tags, generate the project dependency graph, and reject forbidden dependency directions, circular package dependencies, deep/internal imports and public-entry-point bypasses, with negative tests proving each rejection.

defaults_pending_po_sa.matrix_dash_cells: Off-diagonal '-' cells in Appendix B are not allowed
defaults_pending_po_sa.same_category_edges: domain-* to another domain-*, and app to app, not allowed without an ADR
defaults_pending_po_sa.tsconfig_base_json: IMPLEMENTED as the alias registry only; strictness stays literal in tsconfig.json
defaults_pending_po_sa.wp03_regression: Bounded exception: WP03 V05, V08, V10, V12, V17 may report only WP04-authorised change
defaults_pending_po_sa.optional_cells: Allowed; graph flags each Optional edge for justification
defaults_pending_po_sa.section_6_1_vs_appendix_b: Appendix B governs where IB-01 §6.1 limits layers to lower layers (eight same-layer Optional cells)
